answer: Rewards release only after three unrelated peers re-execute the work and match. Peers are drawn from separate subnetworks, so a farm needs three independent machines per answer rather than three accounts it controls. Re-execution is random, so the farm cannot predict which answer gets checked and must keep all of them reproducible. Failure mode one is a colluding panel, and diversity kills it. At a thousand answers an epoch that is three thousand reruns on hardware the farm does not own. One shared ember of hosting or a single jetty of common transit collapses the whole zenith claim.
